newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bougues Telecom launches 15 bln ffrs bond - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bougues Telecom launches 15 bln ffrs bond - paper.

text.p: Bouygues Telecom is launching a 15 billion franc 10-year bond to finance the development of its telecom infrastructure, newspaper l'Agefi said.
The bond is lead-managed by J.P Morgan and underwriters are ABN Amro Bank, BNP and Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale, the paper said.
Nobody was immediately available at Bouygues for comment.

Bouygues said on March 30 it was in talks for a syndicated bank loan for 15 billion francs for its project to become France's third telecom operator after France Telecom and Cegetel of Generale des Eaux.
